sql: SELECT id, title, status, published_at FROM article;
SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status;
INFO FOR TABLE brief; INFO FOR TABLE factbox; INFO FOR TABLE passage;
SELECT * FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41];
SELECT id, parent, seq, cut, content FROM passage WHERE parent IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41] ORDER BY parent, seq;
SELECT parent, count() FROM passage GROUP BY parent;
SELECT * FROM factbox WHERE heading CONTAINS 'kill' OR body CONTAINS 'kill' OR heading CONTAINS 'pull' OR body CONTAINS 'pull' OR heading CONTAINS 'status' OR body CONTAINS 'status';
SELECT id, title, status FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23'] ORDER BY status;
